rationale: The existing Dashboards 'Visualize' specs (visualize.spec.js, visualize-vrl.spec.js) exercise the read-only logs Visualize tab (pageType='logs'), which is a different PanelFieldList page key and a read-only/disabled stream select. No existing E2E spec touches the 'Build' view-mode toggle (logs-build-toggle), the Dashboard 'Add Panel' new-panel flow's stream list, or the index-dropdown-stream behavior under test. The fix (STREAM_LIST_WITHOUT_STREAM = {metrics, build}) is a brand-new behavior in the Dashboards area, so a new spec in Dashboards/ is warranted; it must be registered in the Dashboards-Visualize shard's run_files.
